Delete old projected-cost snapshots for one stack

## Synopsis

```text
Read stored cost history without running a plan. Terraform directories resolve the current project identity without --stack; --include-workspace opts into workspace scoping. Pulumi histories use --stack.
```

```text
finfocus cost history prune [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  finfocus cost history prune --stack dev --older-than 365d --dry-run
  finfocus cost history prune --stack dev --keep 100 --force
```

## Options

```text
      --force[=true|false]   Skip the confirmation prompt
  -h, --help[=true|false]    help for prune
      --keep int             Keep the N most recent snapshots (0 = no limit)
      --older-than string    Remove snapshots older than a duration (365d, 6m, 2y)
```
